lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Four crates. Ration packs, medical, and one crate that's nothing but forms. Under armed guard, on a ridge, in a war.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Of course it is. The paperwork is the part that matters. It always was, in every century I have now stood in.

lines.speaker: ash_smith
lines.text: Take the plate. Cut off a carrier by somebody with no torch and a great deal of time, which is the only kind of work we do out here.
